output_summary.rejected_answer: The correlation is quantified using the AUC-ROC score. Specifically, (A_l(q, p1), ..., A_l(q, pC)) is treated as a classifier's prediction for the model output label—with A_l(q, pi) equivalent to the probability of the model outputting label i—and the AUC-ROC value of this prediction relative to the actual model output is computed, denoted as AUCROC_l. [E3] The AUCROC_l for deep layers approaches 0.8, indicating a strong correlation. [E4]
